name: Matching pennies
summary: Two-player zero-sum game where each hides heads or tails; Even wins on a match, Odd wins on a mismatch.
rules_text: There are two players, Even and Odd. Each secretly chooses a side of a penny, Heads or Tails. Choices are made simultaneously and kept hidden. After both have chosen, they are revealed at the same time. If the two pennies show the same side, both heads or both tails, Even wins and takes both pennies. If they show different sides, one heads and one tails, Odd wins and takes both pennies. The game is zero-sum with one winner and one loser per round. In the repeated form players keep score over many rounds.
rating_reason: Two-player simultaneous hidden penny match, zero-sum payoff matrix
